business_summary: Sankyu Inc. provides logistics services in Japan and internationally. The company offers logistics solutions, such as freight, air freight, international multi-modal transport, and import and export operations; port operations, such as loading and unloading, ship agency business, packaging, port warehouse, and port base information; cargo transportation, environmental logistics, and hospital relocation work; art and event transportation, hazardous materials logistics, and waste transportation; and logistics consulting. It is also involved in plant engineering, procurement, and construction services, as well as steel, chemical, and petrochemical on-site operations. Sankyu Inc. was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Sankyo Inc.는 일본 및 국제적으로 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 화물, 항공 화물, 국제 복합운송, 수출입 운영과 같은 물류 솔루션을 제공합니다. 하역, 선박대리업, 포장, 항만창고, 항만기지정보 등 항만운영 화물 운송, 환경 물류, 병원 이전 업무; 예술 및 행사 운송, 위험물 물류, 폐기물 운송; 및 물류 컨설팅. 또한 플랜트 엔지니어링, 조달, 건설 서비스는 물론 철강, 화학, 석유화학 현장 운영에도 참여하고 있습니다. Sankyo Inc.는 1917년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
